identity.name: Current Reviews in Musculoskeletal Medicine
identity.source_note: Live page is Cloudflare-protected: WebFetch returned a 303 redirect to idp.springer.com auth, and the Apify rag-web-browser headless render returned only a 'Client Challenge' interstitial. Encoded from the CURRENT live page rendered in a real headless browser session (Chrome) which passed the Cloudflare challenge. Content is Springer Nature's standard journal submission-guidelines template with the journal-specific 'Types of papers: Reviews and Invited Commentaries'.

encoding_notes: Types of papers listed only as 'Reviews and Invited Commentaries'. 'Reviews' -> review; 'Invited Commentaries' -> editorial (no exact 'commentary' enum slot).
Guide is Springer Nature's standard journal submission-guidelines template; page_size, margins, line_spacing, alignment, first_line_indent are unspecified for this journal -> null.
Font '10-point Times Roman' is stated as an example ('Use a normal, plain font (e.g., 10-point Times Roman)'), encoded as the recommended font/size.
Abstract is unstructured, 150-250 words; encoded max_words=250 (upper bound). Applied to the review type.
Keywords: 'Please provide 4 to 6 keywords' -> required min 4 / max 6; case and separator unstated -> null.

References: numbered citations in square brackets, numbered in citation order, DOIs included as full links, journal names abbreviated per ISSN LTWA -> style vancouver / in_text bracket / order cited / journal_abbrev nlm / include_doi true.

et_al_threshold not shown in the live reference examples -> null. (A third-party CSL for this journal implies list 6 then et al for the Springer Basic style, but the live guide does not state a threshold, so left null.)
Figure DPI is tiered: line art 1200 dpi, halftone/photograph 300 dpi, combination 600 dpi. Single min_dpi set to 300 (photograph floor) - see schema_gaps.

Figure formats: EPS preferred for vector, TIFF for halftones (MSOffice files also accepted, no enum slot). Figures submitted within the body of the text; separate files only if the manuscript is too large -> separate_files false.
Tables placement not explicitly stated; defaulted to in_text (tables built with the Word table function and cited in text). Table caption above/below not stated -> caption_position null.

Declarations placed in a 'Declarations' section before the reference list: Funding, Competing interests, Ethics approval, Consent, Data availability, Author contributions. Competing interests / declarations are mandatory ('submissions that do not include relevant declarations will be returned as incomplete') -> required funding + conflict_of_interest. Acknowledgments go on the (separate) title page.
Max 3 levels of displayed headings (count limit only; no case/bold/italic rule) -> headings null.

Double-blind not stated for this journal (guide references single OR double blind generically) -> double_blind false; separate_title_page true because the guide references a 'separate title page' carrying author info, acknowledgments and contribution statements.
ORCID recommended, not required -> orcid_required false. Cover letter referenced only for re-use disclosures / reviewer suggestions, not mandated -> false.
Submission system not named in the guide text -> null (Springer journals typically use Editorial Manager, not stated here).
